notes.title: Final Achievement Fixed and Graphics Options
notes.content:
The final achievement is running in all its glory!
A graphics selector has also been added so that more people can play.

If you have any more problems, don't hesitate to contact us. We will try to fix it as soon as possible.

Thank you all.
Sincerely, Ponko Games.

notes.title: Level 31 Fixed
notes.content:
The mysteries of digital games—I tested all the levels several times, and everything was working fine. However, after launching, I received notifications that level 31 was broken, and indeed it was. The code seemed correct, but it still didn't work. Digital games have some kind of witchcraft that I will never understand.

I have also received reports of other bugs and suggestions for improvements, which I should fix soon. I apologize if these issues disrupted your gameplay. However, as an old Nintendo commercial in my country used to say, 'Here, we work hard to make your life more and more complicated.'

Jokes aside, we will soon release updates that include a graphics selector and other features.

Thank you all.
Sincerely, Ponko Games.
